examples.text: If the whistleblower submitted a timely response, pursuant to Step 9, the Claims Review Staff will consider the issues, along with any supporting documentation, and make its Proposed Final Determination.

glosses: Happening or appearing at the proper time.

examples.text: […] and the timely dew of sleep, / Now falling with soft slumbrous weight, inclines / Our eye-lids […]

examples.text: On May 14, 1997, the jury convicted the defendant, who currently is serving a fifteen-month sentence. The defendant timely appeals.

examples.text: This would be an opportune spot for a picnic.
